mount-the-vault.note: re-pointed 2026-09-04 (CRE-ruled, task-audit 09-02 gate bin). Was mapped to vault-boot.md, which produced a spurious REVIEW every run: the prompt defers to CLAUDE.md at the VAULT ROOT (the CANONICAL boot doc, ^obs-160) and vault-boot.md is a derived install of it. doc_sha() now resolves WORKFLOWS/ then the vault root, so a `tracks: CLAUDE.md sha:...` stamp on this prompt clears the row EXACTLY rather than suppressing the verdict (DIR-018).
